headline: Signed a chapter land lien for 7 Foster Lane; discussed changes to the Senior Work off Policy.
summary: Changes to the Senior Work off Policy will be made at the next meeting. The chairman discussed upcoming Planning Board projects and how they may affect the office. Abatement and exemption applications were reviewed in executive session.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 8, 2026 open and executive sessions, 3-0 unanimous.
Signed one chapter land lien for 7 Foster Lane.

decision_titles: Chapter land lien at 7 Foster Lane
plain_text:
TOWN OF SUTTON
BOARD OF ASSESSORS
 4 UXBRIDGE ROAD
SUTTON, MA  01590-1702
  508-865-8722
Meeting Minutes – September 15, 2026
Present: Robert Nunnemacher, Chairman
 Tracey Tardy, Principal Assessor
 Matthew Read, Assessor
Meeting called to order at 5:00 p.m.
1.         The Board voted unanimously to accept the open session meeting minutes and executive session
            meeting minutes of September 8, 2026
2.         Old & New Business
The Board discussed a few changes to the Senior Work off Policy – the Board will review the policy over the
      week and make final changes next meeting
The Principal Assessor reviewed with the Board the Assessor Meeting she attended earlier in the day
The Chairman discussed the Planning Board meeting on Monday September 14, 2026 and the upcoming projects
      and how they may affect the Assessors’ Office
3.         Decisions & Actions Taken
The Board signed one (1) Chapter Land Lien:
7 Foster Lane
4. Adjourned Open Session @ 5:30 to enter into Executive Session regarding
            Abatements/Exemptions
The Board entered into executive session to review abatement and/or exemption applications pursuant
to Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 59, Section 60, and Chapter 30A, Section 21, Item number 7. We are 
meeting in executive session to comply with Chapter 59, Section 60, which limits inspection of Chapter 59 
abatement and exemption applications to assessors and the deputies, clerks and assistants of the assessors, and 
certain other parties listed in the law. Chapter 30A, Section 21, Item number 7 permits public bodies to meet in 
executive session for the purpose of complying with general laws. 
The Board of Assessors adjourned its open meeting at or about 5:30 p.m. 
Respectfully Submitted,
Linda Hicks, Assistant Assessor
